definition: The words a reader could mistake this one for, each linked to its own entry. The link runs both ways: every entry named here names this one back.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of the `confusable_with` field, which this word labels on an entry's own page: "Ids of records a reader could mistake this one for." and "Symmetric: every id named must exist and must name this record back."
